Golan Levin.bio: Artist and educator working with computation, gesture, and responsive environments; co-author of Code as Creative Medium.

Tega Brain.bio: Artist and environmental engineer examining ecology, data, and computation; co-author of Code as Creative Medium.

Lauren Lee McCarthy.bio: Artist examining social relationships and automated systems; creator of p5.js, a platform for creative coding and education.

Zach Lieberman.bio: Artist making expressive drawing and animation tools with code; co-creator of openFrameworks and co-founder of the School for Poetic Computation.

Gene Kogan.bio: Artist and programmer working with generative systems and open educational tools. Eyebeam records his 2015 project residency jointly with Lisa Kori.
